description: AWS offers cloud computing, storage and networking services. Learn the names of the main parts, read a simple static-site plan and understand access and cost before creating anything. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain identity and access with iam

seo.title: AWS Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn AWS with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
